data.long_description:
Discover an exquisite 2-bedroom apartment in Beach Walk Grand, Dubai Islands (Deira). This off-plan resale offers a luxurious living experience with panoramic sea views and contemporary finishes.

Overview

Freehold off-plan resale
2 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms + guest powder room
Maid’s room with en-suite shower
Built-up area: 1,530 sq.ft
Large sea-facing balcony with outdoor seating space
Fully furnished with premium fixtures and appliances
Modern fitted kitchen with granite countertops and integrated high-end appliances
Shared amenities: outdoor swimming pool, fully equipped gym, children’s play area
Building services: 24/7 security, secure covered basement parking, CCTV and on-site management
Pet-friendly (subject to building rules)
High-speed internet and TV package available (optional)
Key Updates (Off-plan Resale)

Configured as 3 full baths + powder room for improved flow
Extended balcony for enhanced outdoor living
Premium furniture and soft-furnishings package included
Option for rental management/letting services for investors
Nearby Facilities

GEMS World Academy — approx. 5 km
Dubai International Airport — approx. 10 km
Downtown Dubai — approx. 20 km
Dining, retail and leisure options within Dubai Islands community
Ideal For

Buyers seeking a turnkey sea-view home from an off-plan resale
Investors looking for high-quality rental potential
Get in touch for more details.
